checks.command: pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime lint && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime test && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime build
checks.proves: Captain mobile source, types, tests and export build remain valid after native/route convergence.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove physical permission dialogs or background behavior.

checks.proves: Runtime configuration and governed registry stay internally consistent.
checks.doesNotProve: Static guards do not prove device lifecycle.

checks.command: manual: install the exact app-captain development build on Android and exercise cold start, update compatibility, notification permission, location permission, camera permission, denied/revoked states, map load and any authority-approved background behavior
checks.proves: Physical development-build evidence proves native permissions and runtime paths on the final candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: A single device run does not prove all backend concurrency.
checks.passCriteria: Every applicable native path behaves according to Product Truth and denied/revoked permissions fail safely without fabricated state.
checks.failCriteria: A declared sensitive capability is unproven, over-permissioned, or behaves differently from the governed contract.
